How do I move it to a subpage of my userpage?
: in the top right corner of the OC page (not this talk page), you will probably see three little dots. one of the options under those dots should say 'Move' if you have rights to do so (I don't remember, it's been a while since I had regular user rights). You can change the first box there from '''Main''' to '''User''', and then change the name of the page to something like [[User:Nyxxx352/Eserine Calmorien]]. Please uncheck '''Leave a redirect behind''', but if you forget we can clean up afterwards, not a big deal. :)
: If you don't see Move, just let us know and I'll move it, just tell me where you want the page and the name to be used (you can leave OC in, if it helps you organize your own thoughts). Then if you want to make a page about her family if needed, you would just name them the same way with that slash, which is a magic symbol to make it a subpage; after the move you'll see in the top left of the new Eserine Calmorien page a link back to User:Nyxxx352. Hope that helps! -- ''[[User:Nae'blis|nae]]'[[User_talk:Nae'blis|blis]]'' 00:25, 22 April 2025 (UTC)
